description: fakeapp/v1 — Simulation leaf that CONSUMES values flowed from TWO upstreams: the downstream half of the dependency + value-flow demo (producers = fakevpc + fakedb). A composer emits it with spec.vpc_id + spec.db_endpoint ABSENT plus two DepEdges, each carrying a ValueFlow; the engine schedules it only after BOTH upstreams are Ready and fills both fields from their statuses first. Its worker fails (terminal) if EITHER is still empty — so a Ready fakeapp proves both edges gated it AND both values flowed.

vpc_id.description: Upstream VPC id; flowed in from a fakevpc's status by a composer ValueFlow (absent on compose, filled before scheduling).

db_endpoint.description: Upstream DB endpoint; flowed in from a fakedb's status by a composer ValueFlow (absent on compose, filled before scheduling).

wired_to.description: The vpc_id the app was wired to — proves the fakevpc flow delivered.

db.description: The db_endpoint the app was wired to — proves the fakedb flow delivered.
